outcome: Uptake of low molecular weight heparin
cohort: 2514 women who delivered between January 1st to December 31st 2016 across three centers in Malaysia
finding: A combination of age, parity, BMI, cesarean section and preterm births were the main indications for postpartum pharmacologic thromboprophylaxis, with low molecular weight heparin being the preferred choice in more than two-thirds of the patients.
